description: The frames the Windows faces are calibrated on against the Mac (ADR-R48 Windows, W7). US federal public-domain NASA video from images.nasa.gov only (no JPL, ESA or partner productions; no segment that shows a child, a still photo or a third-party feed). One subject per person, split by subject into fit and validation. Each segment is one continuous shot of the subject, decoded at 10 fps and 1,280 px on the long side; frames lists each decoded frame's SHA-256 (raw RGB24 rows) in order, frame k at start + k / fps. No frames, faces or video are kept in the repository: tools/frames/calibrate/calibrate.py fetches, decodes and checks them, and refuses a frame whose hash differs.
